scope: State-level primary sources; these are not additional countries in the global jurisdiction total

records.title: PC/Pretensioned Bulb-Tee Girder (Debonded Strands), xs1-121-1
records.evidence: Dimensioned typical section with girder depth D and 47.25 in top flange, plus reinforcement template; girder depth is a project variable.
records.remaining: Read the companion xs1-121-3 and user guide; select a specified depth before implementing a named profile.

records.title: FY 2026-27 Standard Plans, Florida-I 36 Beam, Index 450-036
records.edition: FY 2026-27; sheet 1 last revised 2019-11-01; sheet 2 last revised 2016-11-01
records.evidence: End view gives 48 in top, 38 in bottom, 36 in depth, 7 in soffit band, and 15 in radius at lower web transition; Index 450-010 gives companion notes.
records.remaining: Reconstruct tangent points of radius and reconcile against published FDOT section-property table before a polygon or curve approximation is accepted.

records.title: Bridge Standards, Beams collection
records.edition: index updated 2026-09-09; beam sheets revised 2024-04 through 2026-06
records.evidence: Index lists A/B/C/D and bulb-tee C/D/E drawings, e.g. sheet 4700 bulb-tee C revised 2026-04, cross-section sheet series 4380/4383 revised 2026-05/06.
records.remaining: The current PDF download endpoint returned unsupported octet-stream to the research tool; retrieve the actual sheet or use the separately indexed historical PDF before transcribing geometry.

records.title: LRFD Bridge Design Manual, Section 5, Figure 5.4.6.1
records.evidence: 14RB, 18RB, 22RB: common 26 in rectangle width; depths 14, 18, 22 in; independent area, centroid, inertia and section modulus table.
records.remaining: MnDOT lists an October 2025 manual, but its edocs download was rejected; compare the newer figure before calling these current standards.

records.title: Engineering Policy Guide 751.22 Prestressed Concrete I Girders
records.edition: live guide accessed 2026-09-22; publication revision not shown
records.evidence: Explicit Type 2/3/4/6 I, Type 7/8 bulb-tee and NU35/43/53/63/70/78 girder designations; bridge standard drawings index provides PDF sheets.
records.remaining: Obtain cross-section standards for each family and distinguish MoDOT variants from any similarly named Nebraska section.

records.title: Bridge Design Manual, Figure 5.4 and Table 5.7
records.evidence: NU35/43/53/63/70/78 girder dimensions and six rows of height, area, perimeter, centroid, I and weight; the manual says designations do not equal exact heights in inches.
records.remaining: Digitize Figure 5.4 including curved haunches; validate profiles against Table 5.7.

records.title: 2026 Bridge Detail Sheets BD-PC1 and BD-PC2: slab units and box beams
records.evidence: 36- and 48-in wide slab and box section outlines, shear-key recess detail, and area/centroid/inertia tables; ten 48-in box sizes B48x24 through B48x54 appear on BD-PC2.
records.remaining: Transcribe each void and shear-key recess from BD-PC1/2; avoid treating the older BD-PS1E link as live because it currently redirects to 404.

records.title: BD-652M Standard Beam Sizes and Section Properties
records.evidence: PA bulb-tee drawing defines W1/W2/W3, D, T1/T2, radii/haunch dimension labels and printed A/Yb/I/St/Sb rows for 36 bulb-tee variants.
records.remaining: Resolve the small lower corner radius/chamfer and table transcription anomaly before matching the published properties; check current PennDOT edition.

records.title: Prestressed Concrete I-Girder Details IGD-23
records.evidence: Tx28/34/40/46/54/62/70 section details and seven-row section-property table, including area and inertia; dimensions are TxDOT-specific.
records.remaining: Trace full midspan perimeter including flange slopes and chamfers; check current Bridge Standards index before publication.

records.title: Bridge Manual Standard Drawings, Chapter 19 Prestressed Concrete
records.evidence: Index lists 28-in and 36W/45W/54W/72W/82W girders with separate detail and design-data PDFs; 19.11 36W details are accessible.
records.remaining: Pair each dimension sheet with its design-data sheet and account for retired 45/54/70-in legacy sections in older manuals.
